description: A brand's offer campaigns: what deal it ran (discount, bundle, free gift…), in plain English, from when to when, how deep, on how many ads and landing pages, with the exact quote it was read from. Grouped from the brand's ads and page captures; a deepening discount (5% → 10%) is one campaign with steps. Use it to answer 'what is this brand running' or to compare two brands' promotions. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again.

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to six weeks back

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to a week ahead

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_campaigns
title: Find a brand's offers
